code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != background]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    def spans(length, separators):
        result, start = [], 0
        for pos in separators:
            if start < pos:
                result.append((start, pos))
            start = pos + 1
        if start < length:
            result.append((start, length))
        return result
    rows = spans(h, row_seps)
    cols = spans(w, col_seps)
    blocks = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in rows for c0, c1 in cols]
    source = max(blocks, key=lambda b: sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(b[0], b[1]) for c in range(b[2], b[3])))
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
    pattern = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1)] for r in range(r0, r1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for br0, br1, bc0, bc1 in blocks:
        for dr, r in enumerate(range(br0, br1)):
            for dc, c in enumerate(range(bc0, bc1)):
                out[r][c] = pattern[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
